snippet.title: Last Watchtower - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4026370/Last_Watchtower/

Last Watchtower is a minimalist roguelite defense game. Gather resources, pick upgrades, and unlock powerful tower abilities. Experiment with diverse builds, withstand relentless monster waves, and grow stronger with every run through permanent meta-progression. 

Music: Clockwork by JHawk
